_comment: Copy this file to services.json (git-ignored) and describe your own projects, or build them on the GUI's Services & Logs page. This file is the GUI's alone - the launcher neither reads it nor needs to. A project groups the services that make one thing work; the logs those services write stay in logsources.json and name the project they belong to.

projects._comment: dir is where the project lives. Every service in it starts there unless it names a directory of its own; a relative one is read against this. It does not have to exist yet. expanded is what the block opens as the first time the GUI sees this project - after that the page remembers how you left it, in its own settings rather than here. A row the GUI creates also carries added, the date it was made: the page shows the newest first, and nothing else reads it. Neither key changes what runs.
projects.name: Example App

runners._criteria_comment: What to watch this service's log for. Each entry is a name you choose, a colour (green/amber/red/blue/grey), an optional file to read instead of the service's own output, and rules. The rules are about the WHOLE log, not one line: mode 'match' is satisfied by any line at any point and stays so, mode 'exclude' holds until the first line trips it and then permanently does not - so a criterion can go dark again. Cleared when the service starts. Display only: it never changes the status, holds anything up, or stops anything.
runners._comment: A script this application starts and owns: its status IS the process's status, and its output comes back on a pipe. detach false means it is a child of the window - closing the application names it and asks before stopping it. Set detach true to let it keep running on its own; it is then started detached and found again by its pid next time.
runners.name: App Server
runners._depends_comment: Other services in this project that have to be up first. Start waits until each of them reports running and Stop takes them down in the reverse order. A name not in this project, a service waiting for itself, or a ring of them waiting for each other are all refused.

runners._comment: Anything else with a command line. It is split the way a shell would split it and run directly - so no pipes, no redirection, no &&.
runners.name: Front End

runners._comment: A container that already exists: this starts and stops it, it does not create it. detach is always true and cannot be turned off - the container belongs to the Docker daemon, not to this application, so closing the window never stops one. Its status is asked for with `docker inspect` rather than assumed, because `docker start` returns the moment the daemon has the job.
runners.name: Database

runners._comment: docker compose up -d / down against one file. Leave services empty to mean everything in it, or name them separated by spaces.
runners.name: Queue
